verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents first-party tool/function calling using OpenAI-compatible tool specifications and explicitly positions it for building agents that call APIs and take actions. Structured outputs (JSON schema and grammar modes) support reliable output formats. However, the evidence does not cover parallel tool calls, multi-step tool loops, or how reliably calls work across open models. Missing for 10: documented parallel tool calling, documented multi-step/agent-loop tool use, per-model tool-calling reliability evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on faithful function/tool calling — including parallel and multi-step tool use — so agent loops run on open models without breaking

citations.quote: Tool calling (also known as function calling) enables models to intelligently select and use external tools based on user input.
You can build agents that access APIs, retrieve real-time data, or perform actions—all through OpenAI-compatible tool specifications.
Force model output to conform to a JSON schema
